meaning: Symbolic discussion board for the runthrough. Plans, the mons they use, the matchups they target or concede, the conditions and threats that decide them, alternatives, and checks. Status says where each claim stands; there is no strength score.

statuses.hypothesis: Proposed from exploration (E1, E2, E6) or reasoning; not checked.
statuses.engine_checked: Executed in the pinned Showdown engine by the science agent (workbench/RUNTHROUGH_CHECK.md).
statuses.native_checked: Native Smogon Champions calculator result, stored with inputs (workbench/board/checks/).
statuses.rejected: Checked and ruled out; kept for history.

sources.label: Native calc: Mega Staraptor at +0 and +2
Shivraj: popular Audino / Snorlax / Slowbro team

plans.title: Gholdengo Memento into Contrary Mega Staraptor
plans.summary: Memento's -2 Atk / -2 SpA becomes +2 / +2 on Contrary Mega Staraptor, and Gholdengo's faint opens a free switch. The pair is already common; the Memento line is not.

uses.role: enabler: uses Memento on its ally
receiver: Contrary turns the drops into boosts

conditions.text: Ally Memento raises Contrary Mega Staraptor to +2 Atk / +2 SpA
Unscarfed Gholdengo moves after Staraptor, so +2 is not on Staraptor's first attack; it starts on the second
Opposing Follow Me redirects Memento: Gholdengo faints and Staraptor gets nothing
Opposing Rage Powder should redirect Memento the same way (Gholdengo is not powder-immune)
Ordinary Fake Out cannot hit Ghost-type Gholdengo; Scrappy Kangaskhan's can
At +0 Mega Staraptor already OHKOs Rillaboom, Sneasler, Incineroar and Archaludon; +2 flips Garchomp from 2HKO to OHKO and Pelipper and Gholdengo from 3HKO to 2HKO

targets.why: The one common target the +2 changes: 2HKO at +0, OHKO at +2 (Brave Bird)

acceptedLosses.why: Our own Gholdengo's slot and turn: it faints to deliver the boost

threats.name: Follow Me
threats.effect: Steals Memento; Gholdengo faints for nothing

threats.name: Rage Powder
threats.effect: Should steal Memento the same way

plans.verdict: Narrow. The boost arrives a turn late and mainly buys the Garchomp OHKO; Follow Me turns it into a lost Gholdengo. Worth a test only if Garchomp is a matchup the team must win.

plans.title: Whimsicott Prankster Memento into Mega Staraptor
plans.summary: Whimsicott learns Memento and has Prankster, so Memento should go first and +2 would land before Staraptor's first attack. Fixes the turn-order condition; redirection still applies.

conditions.text: Prankster gives ally-targeted Memento priority, so +2 applies on turn one
Follow Me and Rage Powder still redirect it

acceptedLosses.why: Gives up its own Tailwind turn and faints

plans.verdict: Worth a test: needs an engine run of Prankster Memento onto the ally.

plans.title: Gholdengo Memento into Contrary Malamar
plans.summary: Same Contrary flip on a non-Mega receiver, which keeps the team's one Mega free.

conditions.text: Same turn-order and redirection conditions as the Staraptor line

plans.verdict: Open: needs its own targets and a native check.

plans.title: Simple Beam Snorlax, Psych Up into Mega Slowbro
plans.summary: Audino Simple Beams Snorlax; Snorlax Stockpiles to large Def / SpD boosts; Slowbro copies them with Psych Up and Mega Evolves for Shell Armor, then wins with Body Press or Stored Power. A long setup, several turns.

uses.role: booster: Stockpile under Simple; can also Body Press
receiver: Psych Up, then Mega Evolve for Shell Armor; Body Press / Stored Power

conditions.text: Base Audino supports the chain; Mega Audino would spend the one Mega and make Mega Slowbro illegal
Three Stockpiles under Simple should reach +6 Def / +6 SpD
Psych Up copies Snorlax's boost stages onto Slowbro

acceptedLosses.why: A support slot whose job ends after Simple Beam

threats.name: Encore
threats.effect: Locks Snorlax or Slowbro into setup

plans.verdict: Open: name the targets and run the threshold checks (does +6 Mega Slowbro survive the strongest hits it will see; does Body Press then 2HKO them).

plans.title: Kommo-o Clangorous Soul, Psych Up onto Toucannon
plans.summary: Found by E6's Cypher path search: Kommo-o raises all stats, Toucannon copies them with Psych Up, Roosts, and attacks with Beak Blast.

uses.role: receiver: Psych Up, Roost, Beak Blast

conditions.text: Psych Up copies the boosts before Kommo-o is removed

plans.verdict: Open: path-search candidate, no checks yet.
